# API Ninjas

> 162 REST APIs for developers, covering finance and market data, geolocation, transportation, banking identifiers, health and nutrition, text processing, and computer vision. Every API shares one key, one host, and one authentication header.

## How to call the APIs

Two different hosts, which is the most common mistake:

- Documentation pages: `https://api-ninjas.com/api/<slug>`
- Live API requests: `https://api.api-ninjas.com/v1/<endpoint>`

Requests are plain HTTPS GETs authenticated with an `X-Api-Key` header. There is no OAuth flow and no bearer token.

```
curl "https://api.api-ninjas.com/v1/stockprice?ticker=AAPL" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY"
```

Use the exact slugs listed below. They are not always the plural or the most obvious wording, and a guessed slug 404s.
